headline: A 1996 executive order set up the President's Council on Counter-Narcotics, a group focused on federal efforts against illegal drugs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order created a council within the executive branch focused on counter-narcotics, meaning efforts to fight illegal drugs. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the council, what powers it has, and how it works cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on drug control
who_it_affects.how: These agencies may take part in or coordinate through the new council, though the exact roles are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 15, 1996; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
